title: Japanese Winter Mountain Hotel
description: A boutique hotel concept in the snowy mountains of Japan, beside waterfalls. Panoramic windows open onto snow, rock and falling water; warm onsen pools sit on the terraces. Inside, the mood is dark and quiet: black timber, stone, paper screens and lantern light. Some windows face the waterfall; others open only onto the pine forest.
role: Concept design, creative direction and visual storytelling - Mariia Andriiuk.
